reference.how_it_was_measured: helicopter: emergency call to landing at the destination (measured); road: map drive time plus a flat 10 minutes (assumed)

road_model.note: free-flow, no traffic; traffic would lower every break-even

verdict: Compared the way the study did, our model puts the helicopter break-even at 36.0 road miles against the study's 32: it agrees with the study to within 25%. With the ground delays the app really uses (waiting for the ambulance and time at the sending hospital, from published transfer studies), the helicopter wins from 8.5 miles. The study allowed the road only 10 minutes for all of that.
